run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the GTestXMLOutputUnitTest suite to verify Google Test XML output generation
test_non_empty_xml_output: test that a Google Test binary produces the expected non-empty XML output document
test_empty_xml_output: test that a Google Test binary with no tests produces an empty XML output
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in the XML testsuites tag is valid and recent
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test that filtered Google Test runs only include selected tests in XML output
